title: AI for Weather Prediction for Africa (Project Umoya)
summary: Project Umoya plans to fine-tune GraphCast and Aurora with African weather data to improve local forecasts for climate-sensitive decisions.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Ishango.ai proposes fine-tuning GraphCast and Aurora using African weather datasets, including reanalysis and station observations. The intended benefit is more locally relevant forecasting for agriculture, energy, and weather services. Data acquisition and model validation remain in progress. Community training and networking support development, but they are not counted here as benefits that AI itself produces.
purpose: Generate more locally relevant weather forecasts for African decision makers.

ratings.reason: More useful regional model forecasts are intended; no completed local forecast-performance improvement is reported.
Improved agricultural and climate resilience through better AI forecasts remains intended.

ai_role.statement: AI weather models would learn from regional observations and generate forecasts.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 12: AI for Weather Prediction for Africa (Project Umoya)

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: Project Umoya plans locally adapted African weather forecasts
